in_sanskrit.name: Sarfuddin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है The owner of the good religion
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sarfuddin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sarfuddin means 'The owner of the good religion' in various languages including Hindi, Urdu, and Arabic. It is a name with deep spiritual significance and is often given to children who are expected to lead with wisdom and faith.
